evidence_levels.finding: Author checkpoint reaches near-paper ARI using same current 31-column CSV, scaler, model.predict and validation; training provenance remains missing.
The author-vs-retrained gap remains nearly unchanged when the evaluation set changes from 2129 duplicated client records to 569 original CSV rows.
Fifth-round post-server broadcast lowers ARI, degrades latent class separation and reconstruction, while giving exactly matching client/server VAE states.
Training seed variation is larger than stochastic inference variation across five author-schedule retrain checkpoints.
Author checkpoint has a more favorable data-to-mixture alignment than A300; mixture separation alone and reconstruction error do not explain the gap.
Author checkpoint may come from a different training endpoint, partition, preprocessing or checkpoint selection protocol.
